section.title: Card Member Accounting Information Update API

Version_1.0.0.title: Overview
Version_1.0.0.description: The @ Work APIs provide a suite of REST APIs that enable system-to-system communication between a Corporate Client's Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and American Express® to automate the common American Express @ Work functionality. The communication between these systems automates the changes made in the Client's ERP, which triggers changes to the American Express Corporate Card program. The @ Work APIs improve efficiency and security through automation, delivering increased program control, faster response time, and cost savings to a Client's Corporate Card program. The @ Work APIs enable Clients to execute Card status update requests as well as Apply For Card requests through their in-house ERP systems.

apply.title: Corporate Card Management: Initiate a Corporate Card Application
apply.description: The @ Work Apply for Card API is an endpoint that initiates a Corporate Card Application, and is applicable for American Express Clients utilizing the Quick Send functionality. This endpoint is available in the following markets: United States, United Kingdom, Australia, Mexico, India, Singapore, Italy, and Japan, in addition to International Euro Card and Global Dollar Card markets.

statusUpdate.title: Corporate Card Management: Update a Corporate Card's Status by Account Number
statusUpdate.description:
The @ Work Corporate Card Status Update API is responsible for handling requests to update the status of a Corporate Card, Corporate Purchasing Card (CPC), or Corporate Meeting Card (CMC). This API currently supports the Cancel Card transaction.

  • The immediate Cancel Card transaction is available in the following markets: United States, United Kingdom, Australia, Canada, France, Hong Kong, Argentina, Germany, Singapore, Mexico, Italy, India, Spain, New Zealand, Austria, Netherlands, Sweden, Norway, Denmark, and Japan, in addition to International Euro Card and Global Dollar Card markets.
  • The future Cancel Card transaction is available in the following markets: United States, United Kingdom, Australia, Canada, France, Hong Kong, Germany, Singapore, Mexico, Italy, India, Spain, New Zealand, and Netherlands, in addition to Global Dollar Card market.

billingAddressUpdate.title: Corporate Card Management: Update a Corporate Card Member's Demographic Information by Account Number
billingAddressUpdate.description: The @ Work Corporate Card Member Demographic Information Update API is responsible for handling requests to update the demographic details of a Corporate Card, Corporate Purchasing Card (CPC), or Corporate Meeting Card (CMC). This API currently supports the Billing Address Update journey and is available in the following markets: United States and Canada, in addition to Global Dollar Card market.

accountingInformationUpdate.title: Corporate Card Management: Update a Corporate Card Member's Accounting Information by Account Number
accountingInformationUpdate.description: The @ Work Corporate Card Member Accounting Information Update API is responsible for handling requests to update the accounting details of a Corporate Card, Corporate Purchasing Card (CPC), or Corporate Meeting Card (CMC). This API currently supports updating the Card Member's Employee ID, Cost Center and Universal ID. It is available in the following markets: United States and Canada, in addition to Global Dollar Card market.

getApplicationDetails.title: Corporate Card Management: Get Details for a Corporate Card Application
getApplicationDetails.description: The @ Work Get Application Details API is an endpoint that is responsible for retrieving various details about a Global Apply for Card (GAFC) Corporate Card Application. This API will assist you in validating whether an Application is pending, rejected or approved. It is available in the following markets: United States, United Kingdom, Australia, India, New Zealand, Italy, and Japan, in addition to International Euro Card and Global Dollar Card markets.

headers.title: Headers
headers.description: The following headers must be used in the specified request types to communicate with the @ Work APIs.

content.name: Request-Id
content.description: A unique ID for the API request.

content.name: Client-Id
content.description: A unique key assigned by American Express to the API consumer for identification.

content.name: Idempotency-Key
content.description: A unique string, generated by the Client, that American Express supports to protect against repeated API calls that can have negative consequences. The server uses this key to recognize multiple attempts of the same request. When the API retries due to failure, the key should be reused to indicate that the same request is being sent. The key should be stored for 24 hours in case of failures. American Express requires a Version four UUID or similar random string that has enough entropy to prevent clashes.

content.name: Authorization
content.description: An OAuth2 Bearer token that consumers use to gain access to the American Express API. The value passed here is the response of the Access Token API. See the Authorization section for more details.

request.title: Sample request header
request.body:
Content-Type: application/json,

Authorization: Bearer {_your_encoded_credentials_},

Request-Id: 0c7296d9-11bf-4e49-a65f-fb8194,

Idempotency-Key: 5bb95736-a548-4731-9d32-6d0e5e,

Client-Id: 00000000-d8v7-262f-33ot-9vh35dsj8x8m

getApplicationDetailsTransactionStatus_2.title: transactionStatus
getApplicationDetailsTransactionStatus_2.description:
The status of the Corporate Card Application. Possible values include:
  • APPROVED_BY_AMEX - The Card Application has been approved by American Express.
  • CANCELLED_BY_AMEX - The Card Application has been canceled or denied by American Express.
  • APPLICATION_EXPIRED - The Card Application has exceeded the maximum days allowed to be pending and is no longer serviceable.
  • SUBMITTED_TO_AMEX - The Card Application has successfully been sent to American Express for processing. Applications in Japan and Italy markets will remain in this status after the Card Applicant submits the Card Application.
  • PENDING_INFO_GATHERING_BY_AMEX - American Express has reached out to the Applicant for additional information.
  • PENDING_WITH_APPLICANT - The Card Application has not yet been submitted by the Applicant.
  • CANCELLED_BY_COMPANY - A Program Administrator (PA) has canceled the Card Application.
  • PENDING_APPLICANT_SIGNATURE and PENDING_PA_SIGNATURE - The Card Application is awaiting a digital signature from the Applicant or the PA, respectively. Signature statuses are only applicable for Italy market Card Applications.
  • PENDING_WITH_COMPANY - The Card Application is waiting for an approval from a PA.
